title: The commit-msg KB-Work judgement lives in one function the hook and refuse_commit_msg share
goal: kg_hooks.hook_commit_msg and kg_trailers.refuse_commit_msg judge a message's KB-Work line through one shared function, so the hook's printed problems and its refusal cannot drift apart. Follow-up of gate ST-3mfjrjom g2 (the refusal was placed in kg_trailers because kg_hooks.py was outside that item's touches), confirmed by the SP-kbrxa4c4 review with this follow-up.

run:
import inspect,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import kg_hooks,kg_trailers
h=inspect.getsource(kg_hooks.hook_commit_msg);r=inspect.getsource(kg_trailers.refuse_commit_msg)
ok=('refuse_commit_msg' in h) or ('hook_commit_msg' in r) or ('judge_work' in h and 'judge_work' in r)
print('one shared KB-Work judgement',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
